release_name: Reliability, Runtime and Module Error Optimization
scope: Cross-release hardening for Step 102-104 modules and shared platform services
major_repairs: Removed duplicate theme initialization that generated Streamlit session-state runtime errors.
Added shared theme bootstrap to all Step 102-104 expansion pages.
Fixed nested JSON duplicate profiling and headerless Reactome pathway parsing.
Preserved generic laboratory CSV and Excel schemas while retaining vendor-aware normalization.
Added idempotent analytics warehouse and dataset readiness backfill with real bundled-file profiling.
Reduced repeated diagnostics and report scans through single-pass quick diagnostics.
Normalized navigation categories, reduced featured-page clutter and repaired typo-aware search ranking.
Added upload size, extension and empty-file preflight to eight high-risk pages.
Synchronized desktop, mobile, store, Helm, Terraform, runtime and policy release versions.
Replaced lexicographic plugin-version comparison with semantic numeric comparison.
Added Windows wheelhouse preflight and raised configured upload capacity to 2 GB.

verification.new_module_runtime: 52/52 pages passed with zero captured exceptions and zero new runtime error logs
verification.scientific_and_platform_regression: release and targeted regression suites passed
verification.analytics_warehouse: 15000 run events, 1800 daily metrics, 90 quality snapshots, 720 system samples, 80 alerts
verification.dataset_readiness: 66/66 registered datasets have readiness records, schema and QC coverage

boundaries: External specialist engines are detected or integrated explicitly; proxy analyses are not represented as genuine external-tool output.
Clinical, diagnostic, regulatory and patient-care use still requires independent validation and qualified review.
The complete 165-page runtime sweep is resource-intensive; all 165 pages passed static validation, while new and high-risk pages received isolated runtime validation.
